**The following are common query parameter instructions:**
For query parameter usage, please refer to the "Function Usage">>>"Configuration Tool" article introduction!
###### Query audio and video encoding parameters
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stMainStream StartChn ="0"></VariCfgSec>
```
> Parameter Note: StartChn query device channel "0" first and second channels; "2" third and fourth channels; "4" fifth and sixth channels; "6" seventh and eighth channels)

###### Query device basic menu setting information
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stBaseInfo></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query IPC setting parameters
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stIpc></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query device model and version
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stVersion></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query the timed snapshot parameters set by the device
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stSnap></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query the power on/off parameters of the device
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stPower></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query the high and low temperature alarm setting parameters
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stTempAlarm></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query GB28181 parameter configuration
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stGB28181></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query the information of the first departmental standard platform (IP, domain name, port)
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><st808CMS1></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query the information of the second departmental standard platform (IP, domain name, port)
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><st808CMS2></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query the detailed parameter information of the first departmental standard platform (mobile phone number, etc.)
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stCarInfo></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query the detailed parameter information of the second departmental standard platform (mobile phone number, etc.)
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stCarInfo1></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query the device's timing recording configuration parameters
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stTimingRec></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query basic information other than AI related
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stSystemInfo StartChn ="1"></VariCfgSec>

```
###### Query AI related information
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stSystemInfo StartChn ="2"></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query device network parameters
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stNetWorkMode></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query device recording parameters
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stRecord></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query enabled recording and audio channels
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stChnRecord></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query the timed snapshot parameters
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stSnap></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query the device speed alarm parameters
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stSpeedAlarm></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query the alarm input settings
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stAlarmIn/></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query the alarm output parameters
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stAlarmLinkage/></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query device network card configuration parameters
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stLocalEth0/></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query device PTT activation status and group
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stPtt/></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query device PTT server IP and port settings
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stPttDcn/></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query WiFi settings
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stWifi/></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query AP settings
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stWifiAp/></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query the device tool menu parameter information
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stDisplay/></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query the device power setting parameters
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stPower/></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query Gsensor configuration parameters
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stGSensor/></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query the device serial port setting parameters
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stSerial/></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query PTZ channel control parameters
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stChnPtz/></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query device substream parameters
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stSubStream></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query recording parameters after ACC is turned off
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stPower></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query disk SMART information
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"> <stDiskSmart></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query voice package file information
```xml
<Control><CmdType>GetAudioList</CmdType><SN>11</SN><Param>0</Param></Control>
```
> Parameter Note: Query the audio file list Param to get 30 at a time, that is, "<Param>0</Param>" queries the 1st to 30th files, "<Param>1</Param>" queries the 31st to 60th files

###### Query software version number
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stVersion></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query 4G network parameters
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stMobileGNet></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query OSD overlay information
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stOSD></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query the private platform device number
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stBaseInfo ></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Query the private platform IP port registration information
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stCMS></stCMS></VariCfgSec>
```
###### Checking the Time Zone and Daylight Saving Time
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stBaseInfo ></VariCfgSec>
```

######Check Temperature Alarm Settings
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stTempAlarm></VariCfgSec>
```
